description: Remaining 5 routing cases for document-governance (DOC-01 already executed separately, per execution-ledger.json), converted from evals/skill-routing-cases.csv for real execution against cloudbox-skills task #7 (statistical-rigor gap). DOC-02/03/04/05 are positive rows (expected_routing=true in the CSV) whose own notes describe document-ownership/deduplication, spec version lineage, document-roles/derived-views, and multi-view architecture documentation -- all squarely document-governance's own subject matter with no note implying a different expected primary. DOC-NEG-03 is the one negative row (expected_routing=false, CSV note: 'architecture/framework task not document governance') and expects no CloudBox skill to select document-governance as primary.
